text:
[Council File 25-0970; CD 2]
Categorical Exemption from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), pursuant to California Code of Regulations, Title 14, Section 15060(c)(2) and Section 15061(b)(3) and CEQA Guidelines pursuant to Article II Section 2 (m); City Attorney report and draft Interim Control Ordinance with urgency clause relative to prohibiting the issuance of demolition permits for occupied residential dwelling units that are or were subject to any form of rent or price control within the past five years in a portion of the Valley Glen community located within the Van Nuys-North Sherman Oaks Community Plan area, and adoption of project findings.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
No
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Interim Control Ordinance prohibiting demolition of occupied rent-controlled residential units in Valley Glen for five years.

outcome.text: Planning and Land Use Management Committee approved item(s) (Aug 25, 2026); Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Sep 8, 2026); Council action final
